# pdfnative-cli

> Official command-line interface for **pdfnative** — an agent-native PDF toolkit.
> Render JSON to PDF (typography, PDF/A, PDF/X-4, CMYK, 27 Unicode scripts), extract
> text, fill/flatten AcroForms, merge/split/extract pages, encrypt/decrypt, sign and
> verify (CMS, LTV), inspect and compare — with a deterministic process contract
> designed to be driven by autonomous AI agents, and byte-reproducible output.
> Zero extra runtime dependencies; all PDF logic lives in `pdfnative`.

Current version: 1.5.0 (built on pdfnative 1.8.0; requires Node ≥ 22).
Verified on 2026-09-16 against the source tree.

This file is an LLM-facing capability manifest (see https://llmstxt.org). For a
machine-readable JSON manifest run `pdfnative schema manifest`; the full contract is
docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md.

## Process contract (how to call it)

- **stdout** carries the primary artifact: a PDF, a JSON report, extracted text,
  a JSON Schema, or a completion script.
- **stderr** carries diagnostics and, under `--json`, a status/error envelope.
- **Exit codes**: `0` success, `1` runtime/check failure, `2` usage error.
- **`--json`** (agent mode): success emits `{ "ok": true, "command", … }` on
  stderr; failure emits `{ "ok": false, "command", "error": { "code", "message" } }`.
  Global flags may be placed before or after the command name (v1.5.0).
- **12 stable error codes** (branch on these, not on the message):
  `E_USAGE, E_INPUT, E_PARSE, E_IO, E_SIGN, E_VERIFY_FAILED, E_CHECK_FAILED,`
  `E_POLICY, E_UNSUPPORTED, E_PASSWORD, E_NETWORK, E_RUNTIME`.
- **Offline by default**: the ONLY network opt-ins are `verify --revocation online`,
  `sign --timestamp <url>`, `ltv --online`, `doc-timestamp --url`, and
  `batch --allow-network`; all SSRF-guarded, no redirects. Failures → `E_NETWORK`.
- **Token economy**: `--summary` (minimal verdict), `--fields a,b.c` (dot-path
  projection), compact JSON by default under `--json` (`--pretty` opts out).
- **`--dry-run`** validates inputs without writing output and never touches the network.
- **Reproducible output** (v1.5.0): global `--creation-date <iso8601>` (or
  `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`) pins every date in UTC — the same input renders to identical
  bytes on every host. Encrypted output is never reproducible (CSPRNG keys).
- **Self-description**: `pdfnative schema <subject>` (Draft 2020-12, 19 subjects
  incl. `render`, `status`, `metadata`, `ltv-data`, `compare`, `batch-manifest`) and
  `pdfnative schema manifest` (capability list) — validate before you invoke.
- **PAdES ladder**: `sign --timestamp <tsa> --profile pades` (B-T) →
  `ltv add --online` (B-LT) → `doc-timestamp --url <tsa>` (B-LTA) →
  `ltv add --online`.

## Commands (21 commands)

- `render` — JSON document/table → PDF (27 Unicode scripts + `--font-file`, math,
  colour emoji, bookmarks, native charts, watermarks, PDF/A, PDF/X-4
  (`--pdfx pdfx4 --output-intent-icc <cmyk.icc> --trapped false`), CMYK colours,
  typography (`layout.typography`; `--split-paragraphs`, `--keep-headings-with-next`,
  `--kerning`, `--font-features`), encryption, streaming). `--strict` turns the 9
  diagnostic codes into `E_CHECK_FAILED`. PDF/A outputs are validated against veraPDF
  in CI (blocking); recipe: `--tagged pdfa<level> --font latin --lang latin`.
- `extract-text` — reading-order Unicode text as `text | json | ndjson`
  (`--runs` for positioned runs, `--password` for encrypted PDFs). No OCR; tagged
  input yields the `/ActualText` source text.
- `fill` — fill, flatten, and/or **export** an AcroForm (`--data values.json`,
  `--flatten`, `--export`); incremental save keeps existing signatures valid.
- `encrypt` / `decrypt` — re-secure with AES-128/256, or remove encryption
  (`--password`, `--stream` for constant memory). Rebuilds the page tree (drops
  signatures/forms, like `merge`).
- `merge` / `split` / `extract` — page-tree ops; support encrypted sources
  (`--password`), output re-encryption (`--encrypt`), and constant-memory
  streaming (`--stream`).
- `annotate` — attach markup annotations and (v1.5.0) `link` annotations (`url`
  validated: http/https/mailto) via incremental save (`--password` for encrypted PDFs).
- `metadata` — update /Info + XMP metadata via incremental save (existing
  signatures stay valid); reading metadata stays in `inspect`. Note: the rewrite drops
  a PDF/X identification (upstream limit) — re-check with `inspect --check pdfx`.
- `sign` / `verify` — CMS/PKCS#7 RSA & ECDSA signing (native constant-time
  crypto; `--timestamp <tsa-url>` for RFC 3161 / PAdES B-T with `--timestamp-timeout
  <ms>`, `--profile pades`, `--digest sha256|sha384|sha512`, `--allow-multiple` for
  multi-signatures, visible `--signature-rect`) and verification with LTV (RFC 3161
  timestamps, /DocTimeStamp revisions, OCSP, CRL). `verify` reports `timestampDigest`
  and refuses a SHA-1 messageImprint under `--strict`.
- `ltv` — PAdES B-LT: `collect` (needs `--online`) / `embed` (100% offline) /
  `add` — archive OCSP+CRL validation data into /DSS + /VRI.
- `doc-timestamp` — PAdES B-LTA: append an RFC 3161 /DocTimeStamp revision
  (`--url <tsa>` required; repeat to renew).
- `compare` — diff two PDFs by text + structure; identical → exit 0,
  different → exit 1 / `E_CHECK_FAILED`. No visual/raster diff.
- `inspect` — metadata (`--iso-dates` → ISO 8601), PDF/A and PDF/X conformance
  (`--pdfx` report), signatures (`--signatures` inventory), annotations, form fields
  (`--form-fields`), encryption scheme (`--encryption`), PDF/UA validation,
  `--check pdfa|signed|encrypted|pdfua|pdfx|"signatures>=N"`; `--summary` =
  `{ pages, encrypted, signatures, pdfa, pdfx }`.
- `batch` — render a directory of JSON inputs in parallel, or run a
  declarative multi-command pipeline (`--manifest tasks.json`, `@<id>` output
  references, `--allow-network` gate). The manifest whitelist holds 14 of the 21
  commands: render, sign, verify, inspect, merge, split, extract, extract-text, fill,
  encrypt, decrypt, annotate, metadata, doc-timestamp (ltv and compare need
  positional arguments and are not yet manifest-callable).
- `govern` — AI-governance / Human-in-the-Loop contract (`rules`, `policy`,
  `verify-issue`).
- `schema` / `completion` — self-description and shell completions
  (bash|zsh|fish|powershell).
- `doctor` — offline environment/capability preflight (`--format json`): CLI /
  Node / pdfnative versions, Web Crypto CSPRNG (required by `encrypt`), command
  count, font inventory (31 font modules / 27 scripts), Unicode version, conformance
  targets. Exit 0/1 — run it as an agent pre-flight.

## Governance (read before autonomous use)

Agents are **draftsmen, never autonomous submitters**: no runtime dependencies,
a local reproduction for every bug, and a mandatory human review before anything
is submitted under a human identity. `pdfnative govern verify-issue <draft>`
gates drafts (exit `1` / `E_POLICY` on violation). See docs/AGENT_CONTRACT.md §6.
